About the Role Jeen Talk is looking for an AI Solution Engineer to design, implement, deploy, and operate AI-powered solutions for enterprise customers. This is a hands-on, multidisciplinary role combining AI, integrations, customer-facing work, and technical problem-solving. You’ll work directly with customers from discovery and solution design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring, and optimization. You’ll build solutions including Voice AI Agents, Text Agents, conversational workflows, and AI-powered conversation analysis, while supporting customers using the Jeen Talk SaaS platform. Integrate Jeen Talk with APIs, CRM systems, telephony/PBX platforms, databases, knowledge bases, and other enterprise systems. Configure prompts, workflows, business logic, AI models, tools, and integrations according to customer requirements. Monitor production AI agents, troubleshoot technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously optimize performance. Support enterprise customers using the Jeen Talk SaaS platform. Work closely with Product, R&D, Sales, and Customer Success, bringing insights from customer implementations back into the product. Manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously and take ownership through successful production delivery.
